tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search offers by price, brand, fuel, provider, term and power. Returns short summaries and the total number of matches. For the next page, send next_cursor as cursor with the same filters and sort; null means no more pages. On publication_changed, search again without cursor.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Get full vehicle, subscription, mileage, fees and availability details. Supply provider and id from search_offers. Link to the offer with source_url exactly as given; it redirects to the provider.
